Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult woman with glossy black hair in two buns, softly separated fringe and long face-framing strands, mint gray eyes and pale softly textured skin. Rose gold phoenix hairpins with delicate chains. Black high-collar fitted traditional fantasy dress, rose gold piping and floral fasteners, fine dark floral material pattern. The same black and rose-gold fitted dress extends into a continuous ankle-length subtly flared skirt, matching black embroidered low-heel shoes. Slim healthy tall 175 cm build. Exactly three equally spaced full-body views of ONE SAME person in one horizontal row: strict FRONT at left, strict 90-degree SIDE profile facing image-left in center, strict 180-degree BACK at right. Consistent identity, clothing, hairstyle, shoes and 7.8-head tall long-limbed anatomy. Relaxed straight upright stance arms by sides. Every figure fully visible from hair to soles with margin, identical height, same baseline. Pure white ground, narrow white gutters, landscape 3:2. No text.
